subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as public metadata-only plugin manifest fields for macOS Computer Use discovery, with host code treating the metadata as discovery rather than permission authorization?
rationale: The request is additive, but it creates plugin API surface tied to Accessibility and Screen Recording discovery, so maintainers need to confirm the public contract and security boundary before implementation lands.

options.title: Accept after owner/security review
options.body: Review the linked PR, confirm the metadata-only trust model and field names, refresh any generated docs, then merge when checks are clean.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Keep this issue open while narrowing provider metadata, platform shape, permission enum, or naming before freezing a public plugin contract.

options.title: Pause until host design settles
options.body: Keep the implementation draft until the macOS host binding model is mature enough to publish this manifest surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner/security review
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR, confirm the metadata-only trust model and field names, refresh any generated docs, then merge when checks are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for plugin manifest metadata and docs surfaces, which makes him the best available owner for the API/security-boundary decision.
